def _components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == grid[0][0] or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
